summary: Iteration 4 fully verified (drag/move/resize items on any page, bold + italic toggles, cover editing with bg/accent/text colors, movable title, extra text/shape elements). Backend: added 3 new pytest cases specifically for iteration 4 (cover persistence, page item font_weight/font_style persistence, PDF export after cover + bold text updates) — 3/3 pass. Existing 31 iteration-1-3 tests unaffected. Frontend: full Playwright end-to-end run covering all 14 requested UI checks — cover editor opens on background click, bg/accent/text color inputs update the flipbook live AND persist via PATCH 200, title click reveals title-specific controls (font/size/bold), add cover text/rect/circle work with correct data-testid pattern (cover-extra-<id>, cover-shape-<id>), cover extras are draggable via pointer down/move/up (verified 90px x-shift, 70px y-shift), photo drag verified (dx=19,dy=27), resize handle drag verified (dw=19,dh=27), bold/italic toggles apply computed fontWeight=700/fontStyle=italic and persist as font_weight='bold'/font_style='italic' after save. All values persisted correctly (bg_color='#ff8800', accent_color='#00ffaa', text_color='#333333', extra_items count=2 with text+shape, saved text content='Hello Cover' with font_weight='bold').

issues: The cover-title DraggableItem has h=0.28 (28% of page height) which creates a large invisible bounding box below the title text — clicking anywhere in that empty zone selects the title (not the cover background). Minor UX quirk; not blocking. Consider making the title item height fit its actual line-box.

When you click on an extra_item (cover-extra-*) inside the cover, its outline (coral ring) is drawn, but the surrounding cover-front <div> also has data-testid='cover-front' — pointerdown on the child correctly stops propagation via DraggableItem, so this works, but it is fragile if a future refactor removes stopPropagation.

critical_code_review_comments: Playwright note: React color/textarea inputs must be updated via the native value setter descriptor (Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set) — assigning .value directly and dispatching events does NOT reach React state. First attempt with plain el.value = '#ff8800' silently failed. Documented in context_for_next_testing_agent.

AlbumPage.jsx DraggableItem uses setPointerCapture on the current target; when a resize drag ends, releasePointerCapture is wrapped in try/catch which is good (guards against already-released pointer).
AlbumEditor.jsx paste handler uses e.clipboardData?.getData('text/plain') and correctly skips when focus is on input/textarea. Not verified via Playwright (clipboard is hard to simulate).
server.py PDF export renders cover.extra_items + item.font_weight / font_style via Helvetica-Bold/Oblique — verified 200/application/pdf/%PDF non-empty after applying cover + bold text.
server.py is now ~907 lines — well over the 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting into modules (auth.py, albums.py, photos.py, pdf_export.py, storage.py, ai.py) — flagged again from iteration 3.

PATCH /api/albums accepts an unbounded cover dict (Dict[str, Any]). Consider adding a Pydantic sub-model for Cover to validate title_x/title_y ranges (0-1) and extra_items schema — currently a malformed extra_item could break PDF export.
seed_data_creation: Two albums created for testing (one per playwright run): 2 photos each, AI-processed. Both cleaned up at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For React 19 color/textarea/range inputs, always use Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set — plain el.value=X silently fails. For drag on DraggableItem items (photos, texts, cover extras, cover title, resize handle), use page.mouse.move → page.mouse.down → page.mouse.move(steps=8+) → page.mouse.up sequence. To open CoverEditorPanel from Playwright, click at 5-10% of the cover-front bbox (avoids title, image, and shape hotspots). Login route: /editor/:id (not /albums/:id/edit). localStorage keys are 'album_token' and 'album_user' (JSON stringified {id,email,name}). Signup returns {token, user} — put both in localStorage before goto /editor/:id.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two Playwright quirks documented in context for next agent.
